source.title: The control of head formation in Planaria by means of anesthetics

stage: A piece (most anterior piece of the anterior zooid)
injury: transverse cuts dividing the anterior zooid into A, B and C pieces; head and posterior zooid discarded

intervention.description: Pieces cut from the anterior zooid were placed in well-aerated well water with no added agent (water control paired with the chloretone series run on 3/4/1916)

readout.method: external form of the anterior end of each regenerated piece classified under a dissecting microscope into five types

notes: Source table 1A, series control, date 3/4/1916, 10-mm worms, fed two days before cutting. Percent table converted to counts assuming n=50 pieces per flask (methods: 'groups of fifty', 'each flask ... fifty pieces'; all table values are multiples of 2). Table percentages include the dead column and sum to 100. Head classes as printed (percent of pieces): normal 78, teratophthalmic 16, teratomorphic 0, anophthalmic 0, headless 0, dead 6. Category 'other' = teratophthalmic + teratomorphic + anophthalmic = 8 pieces: regenerated heads with abnormal eyes/shape or no eyes (Child's classes of anterior ends); mapped to AP-identity family with normal and headless kept separate.
